title: Make it kinder, sharper, yours
goal: AI feedback is a conversation — refine your saved set with small follow-ups so it sounds like you.

blocks.title: Feedback is a conversation
blocks.body:
The feedback set you saved is a solid first draft. Now make it *yours* — don't start over, just nudge it.

Small follow-ups do the work: "make this warmer", "add one concrete next step", "cite the exact line you mean", "sound less like a report, more like me". Each one keeps what's good and fixes one thing.

blocks.template: A weak student's essay missed the main argument. The kindest, most useful follow-up asks AI to {{tone}} and {{next}}.

options: keep the tone warm and name one real strength first
add one concrete next step the child can actually act on
compare them to the top of the class

blocks.scaffold: Improve this feedback set — keep it warm, name one real strength in each comment, and add one growth-oriented next step the {{gradeBand}} student can act on. Make it sound like a {{subject}} teacher who knows them.

blocks.question: How confident do you feel refining AI feedback so it sounds like you?
